en: Sepia-toned street scene showing an early 20th‑century European city. The view looks down a cobblestone avenue with tram tracks and a tramcar in the center distance. Multi‑story stone buildings with ornate facades line both sides; awnings shelter storefronts and pedestrians in period clothing (long dresses, hats, suits). A clock projects from a shopfront on the left, and several business signs hang above the sidewalks. The architectural style is central‑European and urban, suggesting a commercial main street.
